title: Chapter 2: Choose Zerg At The Beginning
content:
Chapter 2: Choose Zerg At The Beginning

Seeing these system prompts, Wu Qing immediately understood the cause and effect. The system and the world he once owned were hidden in order to avoid rejection by the will of the universe in this world.

His strength came from other worlds and carried the marks of other worlds. The system consumed his strength and used it to improve his potential qualifications.

Then the marks that did not belong to this world on him, an ordinary person, were eliminated, and finally he was perfectly integrated into this world.

For some unknown reason, he was thrown on the battlefield and made to stage a desperate escape.

Now he was starting all over again. Even the space equipment on his body was taken away by the system, and his clothes were changed into ordinary linen clothes in this world.

Except for himself, all external things disappeared.

Fortunately, the system finally generated a StarCraft game base for him in this world at the cost of consuming the luck of the world affiliated with the system after the fusion.

Specifically, he could choose which of the three races, the human race, the Zerg race, and the Protoss race, to build a base.

"The system still loves me!"

Wu Qing rarely teased, the golden finger was still there, and he was in a good mood.

"Which tribe should I choose? I am now in the jungle and need to send troops to rescue me quickly. Do I have any choice other than the Zerg?"

Wu Qing didn't care about resting and ran straight to the depths of the valley ahead.

He wanted to use this time difference to quickly build a Zerg base. If he was unfortunately found in advance, he could only risk his life to buy time for the construction of the base.

Without the golden finger, relying entirely on his own strength, he felt that he could not escape the pursuit of these green-skinned people who were more difficult than hunting dogs.

When he came to the deepest part of the valley, he needed to climb rocks to go forward, so Wu Qing stopped here.

He thought about it and opened the system interface. There were only three single-choice icons for selecting the base of the StarCraft game on the system interface.

The icon of the human race is the machine gunner, the icon of the Zerg is the puppy, and the icon of the Protoss is the fanatic.

Wu Qing selected the Zerg icon, and the icons of the other two tribes dimmed.

After silently reciting in his heart, the phantom of a Zerg mother nest appeared in the real world.

Wu Qing put down the mother nest on the spot. The mother nest with strong adaptability did not choose the place. A building composed of organic matter appeared out of thin air.

After the mother nest was built, organic matter began to spread around, spreading like a carpet. Organic spread is the prerequisite for the construction of most Zerg buildings and the symbol of Zerg territory.

Four terrifying alien insect worker bees the size of a car appeared out of thin air and gathered next to the mother nest to wait.

Three maggot-like larvae also drilled out of the mother nest. They were more than one meter long and looked very creepy.

"Master!"

A loud shout in the spiritual consciousness, with Wu Qing as the master, the collective consciousness of the Zerg was born in this world!

"This construction speed is good, it should be in time!"

Wu Qing did not have time to pay attention to the changes caused by the first appearance of the Zerg in this world. He had to make the Zerg have a certain combat capability in a very short time.

At this time, the system interface became an operating interface similar to the StarCraft game, and Wu Qing could control the Zerg through consciousness.

The system's current resource energy: 750, gas: 150

Wu Qing saw that there were resources, and immediately ordered two worker bees to the location he specified, one to build a hatching pool and the other to build a reproductive body.

The two worker bees pupated, and the mother nest transmitted energy to them through organic spread. The hatching pool consumed 150 energy points, and the reproductive body consumed 75 energy points.

Wu Qing used the time needed for construction to look at the energy and gas in the system resource column, and he had an epiphany in his heart.

"The system has indeed optimized the game settings, otherwise there would be no place to find crystal ore and high-energy gas in this world."

In order to adapt to the new world, the system made two important setting changes to the game base.

One is that in terms of system resource acquisition, it is no longer limited to the two types of collectable resources in the game, crystal ore and high-energy gas.

In this world, everything can be converted into matter and energy. As long as it is tangible, visible, and perceptible, it can be converted into system energy.

Like minerals, trees, soil, sunlight, ubiquitous free energy, etc.

In this world, even if resources are not mined, relying on the mother nest and organic spread to absorb and convert solar energy and free energy, a lot of energy can be obtained every day.

Anything invisible and imperceptible can be converted into the system's Qi.

Like luck, cause and effect, merit, faith, prestige, influence, popularity, emotional power, etc.

As long as it is related to Wu Qing or the Zerg, the system can automatically absorb it.

What's more amazing is that enemies, prey and other creatures that have a causal relationship with Wu Qing can also choose to convert matter and energy when they lose their lives.

Seeing the system prompt, Wu Qing realized that the greenskins he killed should have been converted into energy and energy by the system, and turned into the energy and Qi of the system.

This is how the existing resources on the system came from.

"What a terrible ability! Isn't this tempting me to fight to support war?"

Wu Qing found that the system became more unrestrained after coming to this world.

The second change in the game setting is that the system has added star settings for all buildings and arms.

Because the various arms units in the game do not correspond well to the strength levels of this world, the system defines the initial state of buildings and arms as no star, and the strength of the arms corresponds to the no level of this world.

One star corresponds to the first level of this world, and so on.

Combat units can upgrade their stars through fighting, or they can produce soldiers of the corresponding star level through star-rated buildings.

Building star upgrades can consume resources to upgrade stars if the premise building star level is sufficient.

"It turns out that the soldiers are weakened. I said that the Zerg soldiers in the era of interstellar should not be just this strength. How can such strength survive in the space environment?"

Wu Qing looked at the two idle worker bees. They were not even at the first level and could only be regarded as ordinary alien insect beasts.

Since they were not needed for the time being, Wu Qing let them collect resources by themselves.

Now the Zerg must go all out to deal with the crisis, and cannot waste the only resources and larvae to produce worker bees.

The two worker bees began to find a good position, break the mountain and dig ore underground. In just a short while, they dug what they wanted. In this regard, they are experts.

All this is a long story. In fact, only a little time has passed, and the reproductive body that consumes less energy has been built.

Wu Qing consumed another 50 energy points to evolve the brood into a defensive ground spike. With this defensive structure, the Zerg's newly born territory had basic ground defense capabilities.

At this time, the system energy was 475 points left, and the hatching pool was also built, so it was possible to start producing the basic Zerg troop of puppies.

Wu Qing selected all the larvae and chose to hatch the puppies. The only three larvae activated the genetic code of the puppies and turned into pupae.

At this time, there was movement from the direction of the valley entrance.
